# StratEdge Workflow

> Workflow intelligence for document-heavy financial operations — intake, documents, tasks, follow-up, and advisory AI in one control layer.

StratEdge Workflow Systems LLC builds software for credit unions, third-party administrators (TPAs), accounting firms, outsourced finance teams, and plan administrators who run recurring, document-heavy workflows.

## Key facts

- **Product:** StratEdge Workflow (live SaaS; public interactive tour on anonymized data)
- **Company:** StratEdge Workflow Systems LLC
- **HQ:** 4695 MacArthur Court, Newport Beach, CA 92660, USA
- **Contact:** info@stratedgeworkflow.com
- **Website:** https://www.stratedgeworkflow.com/
- **Traction:** Active pilots and implementations with credit unions, TPAs, and accounting firms (no public customer list without permission)
- **AI:** Server-side, advisory assistant grounded in live workflow records — not autonomous filing or compliance decisions
